parameters.name: DO_STATS
parameters.prompt: Compute and apply statics to sea level?
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' to compute the source-receiver static to sea level and apply it.

parameters.name: W_VEL
parameters.help: What is the water velocity (ft or m per sec) used for static correction to sea level.

parameters.name: CHEADER1
parameters.help: Choose one of the primary headers to match the SIN database.

parameters.name: CHEADER2
parameters.help: Choose one of the secondary headers to match the SIN database.

parameters.name: SHIFT
parameters.help: What time shift (in seconds) should be applied to the header in order to match the database entry?

parameters.name: TOLER
parameters.help: What tolerance (in seconds) is allowable for matching the headers and database entry for time of shot?

parameters.name: IUSE_TRC
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' to use valid trace numbers from the header to match the database.  They must have been assigned previously.

parameters.name: KILL_CDP
parameters.prompt: Drop traces with NULL CDP headers?
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' to discard traces which have a NULL CDP header.  (ex. traces that fell outside a bin space definition.)

parameters.name: KILL_SRF
parameters.prompt: Drop traces with NULL receiver headers?
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' to discard traces which have a NULL REC_SLOC header. (ex. traces that did not have an assigned receiver position.)

parameters.name: IVERBOSE
parameters.help: Select 'Yes' to list shot and channel of every trace that had a null header loaded.
